neighbours.label: the suffix of Diet-itian / Diet-etic(s) (dietitian, dietetics)
fire: A registered Dietitian can help you plan meals that lower cholesterol.
She earned a degree in Dietetics and now works in a children's hospital.
The American Dietetic Association published new guidelines on sugar.
Ask the hospital Dietitian before changing your diabetes diet.
The Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics surveyed two thousand adults.
Our team includes two nurses, a physiotherapist and a Dietitian.
The study appeared in the Journal of the American Dietetic Association.
After surgery, a Dietitian visited him to discuss soft foods.

She earned a degree in nutrition and now works in a children's hospital.
The American Heart Association published new guidelines on sugar.
Ask the hospital nurse before changing your diabetes diet.
The Academy of Nutrition surveyed two thousand adults about breakfast.

The study appeared in the Journal of the American Medical Association.
